claims.content: Place a successful bid on an auction item

goal.raw_text: Place a successful bid on an auction item

claims.content: Customer
The customer must be signed in to the system.
The customer must have the required minimum information required to bid.
The customer places a bid on an auction item.

trigger.raw_text: The customer places a bid on an auction item.

claims.content: The customer views the Product Details Page for an auction item, which displays current bid information including Current High Bid, Opening Bid, and Bid Increment.
The customer enters a bid amount in the 'Your SmartBid' field or selects a predefined bid increment option.
The system validates that the entered bid meets or exceeds the minimum required bid (Current High Bid + Bid Increment).
If the bid is valid, the system displays a confirmation popup DIV asking the customer to confirm they wish to place the bid using a SmartBid on a credit card ending in XXXX.
The customer clicks 'Yes, Place SmartBid' to confirm the bid.
The system records the bid with timestamp and updates the Current High Bid if this bid is higher than any existing bid.
The system displays a success message confirming the bid has been placed and shows updated bidding history.
The bid is recorded to 1/100th of a second.
All relevant bidding information is streamed into the customer’s browser without requiring a page refresh.
If the customer is the winning bidder, they are entering into a legally binding contract and must pay for the item(s) upon receipt of the 'winning notification' e-mail.
